text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... No! Damn it! Aaargh!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Haha.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: So, that's the Twinkle Series Festa...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Just... amazing!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely! It was well worth sneaking
out of the
hospital for!
choice_data_list: 思わず見入っちゃいましたね
choice_data_list_en: I couldn't help but be totally entranced.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Ah! Um... well...
choice_data_list: 病院から抜け出してきたんですか！？
choice_data_list_en: Did you sneak out of the hospital?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
No. Don't be ridiculous. I got the
doctor's
permission to come, of course.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I don't want to bore you with that.
More
importantly...
choice_data_list: そういえば貴方のご病気って……
choice_data_list_en: Come to think of it, about your illness...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to double-check with my
father whether
we've got any more
useful footage of Festa lying
around.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I want to do as much as I can to help,
even if it's
only a little.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: It'd be my pleasure! So, Trainer...
choice_data_list: えっ、いいんですか？
choice_data_list_en: Wait, are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Please... help Festa live her life to the
fullest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Right then, that's my debut, over and
done.
What'd you think?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Can we start making concrete plans for
me to
make it to the Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among all the G1 races in the world, the
Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe stands at the
very top—a
summit that every
Umamusume dreams to one
day conquer.
choice_data_list_en: (The "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe"—!!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around the world, debates abound over
how the
race is best approached. Some
people view
classic year Umamusume as
having the highest
advantage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crux of that discussion is whether
the
challenge should be attempted when
the
Umamusume is oozing with ambition
or after
they've fully honed their skills
during their senior
year.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Why is your approach so timid?
choice_data_list: 準備期間も含め、挑むタイミングは考えたい
choice_data_list_en: Including the preparation period, I want to consider the timing of when to challenge it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the contrary, watching her debut
race just
now has filled me with
aspiration.
choice_data_list: もちろん違うよ
choice_data_list_en: Of course not.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Maybe I get it. I just debuted, and
you're a
rookie yourself.
choice_data_list: 君を世界で勝たせるための情報がほしい
貴方を世界で勝たせるための情報がほしい
choice_data_list_en: I need intel to help you win on the world stage.
I need the intel to help you win on the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Makes sense. Let's gather as much useful

information as we can. We have to use
our time
wisely.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Obviously not. Only an idiot would rush
in
unprepared.
choice_data_list: 反対はしないんだな
反対はしないんだね
choice_data_list_en: So you're not going to object.
So you're not going to object, then.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Bets are more thrilling when you go all
in.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And if you're going all in, you gotta
know your
chances.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Since we don't have any goals along the
way,
while we do our research, let's just
race in
whatever up until my classic year
starts.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So, how long do you think we should
hold fire?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Keisei Hai is a classic year G3 race
held in
early January. It's 2,000 meters
on turf and held
at Nakayama
Racecourse—a track notorious for
its
steep hill.
choice_data_list: 来年の『京成杯』まで、はどうだろう？
来年の『京成杯』まで、はどうかな？
choice_data_list_en: How about until next year's Keisei Hai?
How about until next year's Keisei Hai?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, not a bad choice in terms of
preparation. I
like your drive.
choice_data_list: 『凱旋門賞』でも急坂はあるし……
choice_data_list_en: Even the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe' has a steep slope...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I guess until then I'll just enjoy the
Twinkle
Series...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... No! Damn it! Aaargh!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This event where everyone puts
everything on the
line in pursuit of
reaching greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Even if the media isn't on my ass, being
in the
Twinkle Series alone won't afford
me any moment
of respite.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Well, I'm definitely feeling
the spark of
being alive.
choice_data_list: 楽しそうな顔をしているな
楽しそうな顔をしているね
choice_data_list_en: You look like you're having a blast.
You look like you're having a blast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her what her mentor said about
living life to
the fullest.
choice_data_list: そういえば君の先生も言ってたよ
そういえば貴方の先生も言ってたよ
choice_data_list_en: Come to think of it, your teacher said so too.
Come to think of it, your teacher said so too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh... I see. Teach said that, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Are you stupid?
choice_data_list: 昔の君はそんなに死んだ目をしていたのか？
昔の貴方はそんなに死んだ目をしていたの？
choice_data_list_en: Were your eyes really that lifeless back then?
Were your eyes really that lifeless in the past?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Rather than wasting your time thinking
of
pointless stuff, shouldn't you be
gathering info
already?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You heard me. Out. I have to get
changed now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa kicks me out of the
changing
room, so I decide to start
doing research while I
wait.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I pull out my smartphone, I can't help
but get
excited about the goal we've set
for January—the
Keisei Hai!
